<a id="summary"></a>

## Summary

Jordan's rulings (2026-08-28): 'let's default to human output, with --json available' (interpreted per skunk's asserted TTY strategy: TTY→human, non-TTY/piped→JSON so agents keep parsing, --json forces JSON anywhere, --human forces the renderer) and the TUI POC verdict accepted ('ship a modest ratatui tui verb, defer React'). Three proven inputs: pocs/human-render (committed — rich renderer over frozen envelopes for search/doctor/error/status, TTY strategy, LEARNINGS.md carries its own promotion shape), scratch/tui-poc (mammoth-ox — 4-pane dashboard against real CLI data, VERDICT.md), and the measured gap both share: NO EVENT STREAM (DL-045 — activity must be mocked from poll deltas; any future web UI hits the same wall). Third pij-team pipeline run.

<a id="goals"></a>

## Goals

- A human running flowspace3 in a terminal sees beautiful output by default on every verb; agents and pipes keep getting the frozen JSON envelope untouched.
- flowspace3 tui ships as a modest, gorgeous ratatui dashboard: roots, live operations, activity, search.
- The daemon exposes a real event stream (status --watch NDJSON) so no interface ever mocks activity again.
- Agent-path integrity: every doc/skill that tells agents how to call flowspace3 is updated for the new default.

<a id="non-goals"></a>

## Non-goals

- React/web frontend (explicitly deferred by the TUI POC verdict ruling).
- Clickable/hyperlinked addresses in the TUI beyond what terminal OSC links give for free.
- Renderer coverage of every future verb — the promotion covers the POC's four plus status/add/get/tree; stragglers degrade to JSON honestly.
